# Bundled fonts

The app embeds these font files in `android/app/src/main/res/font/`. They are
**not** covered by the project's MIT license; each keeps its own, and the SIL
Open Font License requires that these notices travel with the font files.

| Font | Files | License |
|---|---|---|
| Barlow, Barlow Condensed | `barlow_*.ttf` | [SIL OFL 1.1](Barlow-OFL.txt) — Copyright 2017 The Barlow Project Authors |
| IBM Plex Mono | `ibm_plex_mono_*.ttf` | [SIL OFL 1.1](IBMPlexMono-OFL.txt) — Copyright © 2017 IBM Corp. |

License texts were taken from the upstream projects:
[jpt/barlow](https://github.com/jpt/barlow) and
[IBM/plex](https://github.com/IBM/plex).
